Returns a list of providers in subscriber’s private network. The response contains provider contact details and the vendor ID.
Visit ServiceChannel University to find out more about the [vendor ID](https://servicechannel.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SCU/pages/571835102/Managing+Private+Notes+Rating+and+Vendor+ID#ManagingPrivateNotes,Rating,andVendorID-VendorID).

No input parameters are required.
